> WEB BROWSERS

MATCHING RECORDS: 4

  • Brave:
    Privacy-focused browser with built-in ad and tracker blocking based on open-source Chromium.
  • Firefox:
    Independent, open-source browser running on the non-Chromium Gecko engine, putting user privacy first.
  • Safari:
    Apple's native, energy-efficient browser for macOS utilizing the WebKit engine with strong built-in tracking protection.
  • LibreWolf:
    An open-source, community-maintained fork of Firefox built specifically for privacy, security, and freedom, featuring built-in ad-blocking, enhanced tracking protection, and all telemetry completely stripped out.
